notes: Modified cash basis school district; no business-type funds (School Nutrition is an Other Governmental fund), so business_type is null. Receipts and disbursements are the Total Governmental Funds column of the governmental funds statement (trimmed pp4-5). Statement of Activities and Net Position is on pp1-3 (report pp5-7); balance_sheet uses its assets and net position section (p3). No liabilities are reported. Cash = fund balances (cash, CDs, county treasurer). Transfers: the statement shows 185,000 out of General and 185,000 into Other Governmental Funds, eliminated in the Reclassifications column, so total-column transfers_in/out are null (net zero). Transfer cross-check: General Fund 'Transfer to other funds' 185,000 (p15) = School Nutrition 90,000 (p18) + Activities 95,000 (p20); Depreciation Fund shows no actual transfer in (budget 78,658 only, p16). In the General Fund budget schedule the 185,000 is printed inside Total Disbursements 5,461,541, so it is recorded as an other financing detail line (-185,000) and the detail_total includes other financing; the basic statement already shows it as Transfers out. Similarly Nutrition and Activities transfers in are inside their printed total receipts (includes other financing). The General Fund column of the statement (p5) combines General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (3,615,636 beginning = 3,390,703 + 217,834 + 7,099). Statement receipt line 'Other' 11,110 split into sale of property 6,975 (General, p9/p12) and School Nutrition contributions 4,135 (p18); the statement's carline and public power district sales tax are classified other taxes. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp11-15, with budgets); the General Fund Components combining schedule (pp7-10) is the same General Fund data and is not duplicated. Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds recorded from their own schedules (pp16-17; no printed totals; Depreciation transfer in, Employee Benefit disbursements and Special Building Security blank in actual column, so skipped; General Fund lines 1291, 2143 blank in actual also skipped). Disbursement detail is by function/program only (no object breakdown), so detail_category is not itemized. Special education, state categorical and federal program lines categorized as instruction (marked review). Special Building insurance adjustments 11,271 is in the printed total receipts, so recorded as revenue. Federal Medicaid lines treated as federal grants.
